class MinStack:
    def __init__(self):
        """
        initialize your data structure here.
        """
        self.s = []
        self.mins = [inf]

    def push(self, val: int) -> None:
        self.s.append(val)
        self.mins.append(min(self.mins[-1], val))

    def pop(self) -> None:
        self.s.pop()
        self.mins.pop()

    def top(self) -> int:
        return self.s[-1]

    def getMin(self) -> int:
        return self.mins[-1]
